value.rationale: The result turns a qualitative contrast between FO and modal descriptions into an exact natural family: one extra FO quantifier doubles the relational distance handled, while the modal frame axiom must literally pay the full distance in modal depth. This is useful as a clean benchmark for correspondence-theoretic succinctness and for frame-validity games.
